question: Which of the following shows modernization to increase the production of goods and services?

options.text: Adoption of old technique with large scale
Adoption of same technique in different way

solution:
The correct answer is __**Adoption of new technology.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The adoption of new technology shows modernization increases the **production of goods and services.**
 
• New technologies and their adoption were to increase **production, productivity, and farm incomes.**
 
• **Major technologies that can help in this sector:**
 
 
• DIGITAL EMPLOYEES
 
• INTERNET OF THINGS
 
• ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
 
• VIRTUAL & AUGMENTED REALITY
 
• BLOCKCHAIN
 
• 3D PRINTING
 
• DRONES
 
• ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• **Production Goods and Services **means goods and services including

 
 
• production and service parts,
 
• components, assemblies and accessories,
 
• raw materials,
 
• tooling and
 
• design, engineering or other services.
 
 
 
• Any increase in production leads to economic growth that is measured by** GDP.**
 
• It represents the total production of** all goods and services in an economy.**
